title: hearth.artifact.promoted v1
description: Immutable revision metadata for the Hearth project-artifacts outbox. Producer and kb-artifact ingestion code are under development; deployed production delivery and consumption are not yet verified. See docs/HEARTH-ARTIFACTS.md.

schema_version.description: Major schema version; bump on breaking changes only. Required constant 1.

artifact_id.description: UUID of the artifact (the logical entity, not a specific revision). Canonical form: lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hex. Identifies the retained revision together with `revision` — the pair (artifact_id, revision) MUST be globally unique and is the durable cross-system key.

revision.description: Monotonic positive integer revision of the artifact. (artifact_id, revision) is the durable identity. Cross-field equality between `artifact_uri`'s trailing path segment and `revision` cannot be fully schema-enforced and MUST be validated by producer and consumer (see docs/HEARTH-ARTIFACTS.md § 'Cross-field identity').

artifact_uri.description: Canonical immutable URI for the retained revision: `hearth-artifact://<lowercase-uuid>/revisions/<positive-int>`. Identifies the exact revision; dereferencing the URI on the producer host returns the retained bytes; consumers MUST resolve bytes through the authenticated Hearth API, never dereference the producer's source path on their own host (see docs/HEARTH-ARTIFACTS.md § 'Resolution and authorization').

project.description: Project namespace slug, lowercase identifier (e.g. `hearth`, `tengine`, `nervous-bus`). Matches the bus channel naming convention.

slug.description: Artifact slug inside the project namespace, lowercase identifier. Combined with `project`, identifies the artifact family; the retained revision is identified by `revision`.

title.description: Human-readable title of this revision. Empty strings are NOT accepted — the title is identity metadata, not free text.

summary.description: Free-form summary of this revision (up to 4000 chars). May be empty.

kind.description: Content kind for downstream rendering / storage. Closed enum: html, markdown, json, text. Any other value (e.g. 'pdf', 'binary', arbitrary strings) MUST be rejected.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest of the retained revision bytes. This is the content digest — distinct from the request digest (which would be a hash of the producing request). `sha256` and `bytes` together uniquely identify the immutable payload; consumers SHOULD verify `sha256` against the bytes returned by the authenticated Hearth API.

bytes.description: Size of the retained revision in bytes. Bounded at 2 MiB (2097152) — the bus carries metadata, not bulk bytes; larger artifacts are out of scope for this event.

provenance.description: Provenance metadata for the retained revision. All properties are optional (the artifact is identity; provenance records how it was produced). Authorization, fetched content, raw HTML, and auth tokens are explicitly OUT of this object — see docs/HEARTH-ARTIFACTS.md § 'What this event does NOT carry'. `dirty` indicates the working tree was not clean at promotion time.

kb_refs.description: Cross-references to KB entries this revision is associated with. Each entry is a safe `kb://<project>/<slug segments>` URI; max 32 entries, all unique. Traversal segments (`..`), absolute paths, query strings, fragments, and percent-encoded slashes are NOT accepted.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at which this revision was durably promoted by Hearth. Combined with the CloudEvents envelope `id` and `time`, this is part of the exact-replay identity (see docs/HEARTH-ARTIFACTS.md § 'Replay and idempotency').
